The person in the trapper hat squats on the pier, looking at them closely. (4) The shirtless man is shown waist-deep, looking at the camera with a focused, almost painful expression while talking. The woman remains in the background, smiling. (5) The man and woman climb out of the water onto the pier. Their skin appears noticeably red, especially on their chests and shoulders. They stand talking with the person in the tan trapper hat. (6) A medium close-up of the person in the trapper hat speaking directly to the camera, gesturing with their hands. (7) A group shot shows all three individuals standing together on the pier, smiling and looking energetic despite the snowy environment in the background.

It aims to entertain viewers through raw reactions to extreme cold and informative post-experience reflections on the physiological effects of the activity.
